parameter-group.name: authentication
parameter-group.label: Authentication and voices
parameter-group.description: The API key and the voice models come from the secrets file, never from this page.

parameter-group.name: fallback
parameter-group.label: Fallback and errors
parameter-group.description: What happens when fish.audio does not answer.

parameter.name: secretsFile
parameter.label: Secrets file
parameter.description: JSON with api_key, reference_id (or a voices list), model, language, speed. Re-read when the file changes.

parameter.name: apiKey
parameter.label: API key (override)
parameter.description: Only if the key should not come from the secrets file.

parameter.name: model
parameter.label: Model
parameter.description: Sent as the model header. The secrets file's model wins when present.

parameter.name: speed
parameter.label: Speed
parameter.description: Prosody speed. 0.9 is HAL's unhurried delivery. The secrets file's speed wins when present.

parameter.name: fallbackGoogle
parameter.label: Fall back to Google Translate
parameter.description: When fish.audio fails, speak through Google Translate's voice instead, so no message is lost.

parameter.name: fallbackLanguage
parameter.label: Fallback language
parameter.description: Language code of the Google voice used as fallback (da = Danish, as the old script did).

parameter.name: errorItem
parameter.label: Error item
parameter.description: String item that receives "HTTP <code> at <time>" when a fish.audio call fails (a rule mails on it). Empty = off.
